title.zh: XRPN 股东投票时对 XRP 通胀漏洞毫不知情
title.en: XRPN took shareholder vote with no knowledge of XRP inflation bug

current_state.zh:
XRP Ledger 基础层支付引擎新近披露的一个漏洞可能允许攻击者以近乎零成本增发数万亿枚 XRP；研究员 Cayden Liao 与 Veria AI 于 9 月 22 日提交报告，Ripple 于 9 月 25 日在 xrpld 3.4.1 中发布闭源修复，仅以“整数运算加固”的措辞加以描述。由 Ripple 和 Arrington Capital 支持的 XRP 储备公司 Evernorth（XRPN）的股东在未获告知的情况下完成了投票，直到 10 月 9 日合并完成当天，官方报告才披露该补丁实际修复的内容。

该漏洞意味着 XRP 1000 亿枚的固定供应上限——Evernorth 储备计划的核心主张——在网络上大约十年间无法被技术性强制执行。此事还引发治理层面的质疑：XRPN 股东是在 Ripple 已知情而他们不知情的窗口期内做出了赎回和合并决定。

据该报道，这一漏洞可能可追溯至 2015 年，仅一笔利用该漏洞的已验证交易就“可能创建远超总供应量的可用 XRP”。该补丁未经过修正案投票即发布，目前也没有该漏洞被实际利用的报道。
current_state.en: A newly surfaced XRP Ledger base-layer bug could have let attackers mint trillions of new XRP for nearly nothing, and shareholders of the Ripple/Arrington-backed XRP treasury vehicle Evernorth voted on their deal without being told about it.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: A newly surfaced XRP Ledger base-layer bug could have let attackers mint trillions of new XRP for nearly nothing, and shareholders of the Ripple/Arrington-backed XRP treasury vehicle Evernorth voted on their deal without being told about it.
updates.detailed_summary_en: A newly surfaced XRP Ledger base-layer bug could have let attackers mint trillions of new XRP for nearly nothing, and shareholders of the Ripple/Arrington-backed XRP treasury vehicle Evernorth voted on their deal without being told about it.
updates.background_zh: XRP 是一种预挖数字资产，其 1000 亿枚全部供应量在 2012 年 XRP Ledger 上线时即已创建，协议中没有挖矿或质押增发机制。由 Ripple 和 Arrington Capital 支持的 XRP 储备公司 Evernorth Holdings 已完成与 Armada Acquisition Corp. 的业务合并，据搜索结果，其资本包括约 4.73 亿枚 XRP 和 3 亿美元总现金收益。
updates.background_en: XRP is a pre-mined digital asset whose full 100 billion supply was created at the XRP Ledger's launch in 2012, and the protocol has no mining or staking mechanism for issuing new tokens. Evernorth Holdings, an XRP treasury company backed by Ripple and Arrington Capital, completed its business combination with Armada Acquisition Corp. and, per search results, is capitalized with roughly 473 million XRP and $300 million in gross cash proceeds.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该披露直接关系到 XRP 供应上限的可信度，而这一主张支撑着 XRP 本身以及 Evernorth/XRPN 这类以持币为核心、股权与 XRP 持仓挂钩的储备公司的估值。同时，此事也使 XRPL 验证者与补丁治理实践受到审视，包括未经修正案投票的闭源紧急发布。
updates.market_impact_en: The disclosure bears directly on the credibility of XRP's supply cap, a claim that underpins the valuation of the token itself and of treasury vehicles such as Evernorth/XRPN whose equity is tied to XRP holdings. It also draws scrutiny to XRPL validator and patch-governance practice, including the emergency closed-source release issued without an amendment vote.
